scripts.build:domain: set -e; for p in domain/*/; do (cd "$p" && gleam build); done
scripts.test:domain: set -e; for p in domain/*/; do (cd "$p" && gleam test --runtime bun); done
scripts.format:domain:check: set -e; for p in domain/*/; do (cd "$p" && gleam format --check src test); done
scripts.build:services: set -e; for p in services/*/; do (cd "$p" && bun run build); done
scripts.test:services: set -e; for p in services/*/; do (cd "$p" && bun run test); done
